summary: Establishment Labs Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary ELSA entered into Amendment No. 3 to its Master Supply Agreement with NuSil Technology LLC on October 14, 2026. The amendment extends the initial term from December 31, 2026 to December 31, 2031, with up to five one-year automatic renewals, and revises terms for medical-grade silicone supply, payment, business continuity, intellectual property and pricing. No price, stake or change of control is involved. This is a routine supply contract amendment; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed.
